---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a tool, helper, or improvement for DogOS
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What

What should DogOS do that it doesn't (or doesn't do well) today?

## Why

Who does this help, and in what workflow?

## Scope

- [ ] New package / tool for the image (which flavor: full / lite / both?)
- [ ] New or changed `dogos-*` helper behavior
- [ ] Build-tree / packaging change
- [ ] Docs

## Constraints

- Does it change any `dogos-*` CLI contract? (Those are stable — flag it
  explicitly if so.)
- Debian archive availability: is the package in Debian forky, Kali rolling,
  or does it need `dogos-extras`?
- Size: rough installed footprint (matters for the lite flavor).

## Extra context

Links, references, prior art.
